title: &aGears of Progress
subtitle: Create from the first water wheel to trains, plus electric power from Crafts & Additions.

quests.title: Ponder Everything
quests.subtitle: Create
desc: &eCreate&r builds machines from spinning shafts and gears. Hover any Create item and &ehold W&r to &ePonder&r it: an animated lesson that shows how it works.
Make a &eWrench&r (rotates blocks; shift-right-click picks up Create blocks) and &eEngineer's Goggles&r (show speed and stress when you look at machines).

quests.title: Power From the River
desc: Machines need rotation. A &eWater Wheel&r on a shaft beside flowing water makes it; a windmill bearing with sails makes more.
Every source has a &estress capacity&r (SU), and every machine uses some. Goggles and a Stressometer show how much you have left.

quests.title: Grind It Down
desc: A &eMillstone&r grinds what you put in: wheat into flour, ores into crushed ore, flowers into dye.
Gears change speed: a large cogwheel driving a small one doubles the speed (and the stress).

quests.title: Crushing Wheels
desc: Two &eCrushing Wheels&r spinning toward each other crush whatever falls between them, faster than a millstone and with a chance of bonus output.
Crushed ore smelts into more ingots than raw ore, and often gives Experience Nuggets too.

quests.title: Wind Through Fire and Water
desc: An &eEncased Fan&r blowing through something processes items in its path: through &9water&r it washes, through &clava or fire&r it smelts, through a campfire it smokes, through &bsoul fire&r it haunts.
Washing crushed ore gives extra nuggets. Put the fan beside a belt for a free furnace line.

quests.title: The Mechanical Press
desc: A &eMechanical Press&r over a depot or belt flattens ingots into &esheets&r. Over a basin it compacts things together.
Iron sheets go into a lot of Create recipes, and into Crafts & Additions parts.

quests.title: The Mechanical Mixer
desc: A &eMechanical Mixer&r above a &eBasin&r mixes ingredients: dough, alloys, liquids.
Some mixes need heat under the basin. That's the next step.

quests.title: A Blaze in a Cage
desc: Right-click a blaze with an &eEmpty Blaze Burner&r to catch it. Feed it fuel to heat the basin above; a &eBlaze Cake&r makes it superheated for a while.
Blazes live in Nether fortresses. A Central Power Battery keeps burners lit for free (see the Lanterns chapter).

quests.title: Brass
desc: Mix &ecopper&r and &ezinc&r in a heated basin to make &eBrass&r, Create's second-tier metal. Brass casing makes the smarter machines (brass funnels, tunnels, arms, crafters).
Yellow Stormwrights: brass is your bread and butter.

quests.title: Precision Mechanism
desc: A &ePrecision Mechanism&r is made by &esequenced assembly&r: a gold sheet passes under deployers and a press several times on a belt. Some come out as scrap, so make a few.
Many advanced machines need them, and so does the Lantern &ePower Core&r.

quests.title: Belts and Funnels
desc: Use a &eMechanical Belt&r on two shafts to link them with a conveyor. Funnels put items on and take them off; chutes drop them down.
A belt through a fan, under a press, past a saw: that's a factory line.

quests.title: The Mechanical Arm
desc: A &eMechanical Arm&r picks items up from one place and puts them somewhere else: depots, belts, chests, machines, even Blaze Burners.
Click the input and output blocks with the arm in hand before you place it.

quests.title: Steam Power
desc: Fill a block of &eFluid Tanks&r with water (a mechanical pump), heat it with Blaze Burners underneath, and put a &eSteam Engine&r on its side. It makes far more stress than any wheel.
Bigger boilers and more burners mean more engines. Ponder the Steam Engine for the full rules.

quests.title: All Aboard
desc: Lay &eTrain Track&r, place a &eTrain Station&r, build a train on bogeys with &eTrain Casing&r and &eControls&r, then assemble it at the station.
Give it a &eSchedule&r and it runs on its own. A rail line between bases is a great party project.

quests.title: From Rotation to Power
quests.subtitle: Create Crafts & Additions
desc: &eCrafts & Additions&r links Create to electricity (FE). An &eAlternator&r on a fast, strong shaft turns rotation into energy.
FE powers Mekanism machines and AE2 networks. Put a steam engine on an alternator and you have a power plant.

quests.title: Power Lines
desc: A &eRolling Mill&r makes rods and wire. Wind &eCopper Wire&r onto a spool, then click two &eConnectors&r with it to string a power line between them.
Large Connectors carry more over longer distances. Run lines from your power plant to every machine.

quests.title: Store the Spark
desc: A &eModular Accumulator&r stores energy; stack several into one big battery. A &eTesla Coil&r charges items placed under it.
Store power by day so night-time machines keep running.

quests.title: The Electric Motor
desc: An &eElectric Motor&r does the reverse: it turns FE back into rotation, at a speed you set. Power a contraption anywhere a wire can reach.
With alternators, wires, accumulators and motors, your factory has no limits but your imagination (and your stress budget).

quests.title: The Clockwork Factory
desc: Steam, brass, precision, trains and electricity: you've mastered Create. The Stormwright's machines hum with your light.
Next: take it to the sky with Create Aeronautics.
